captions.detailed: A sit-down driving arcade cabinet featuring a dark blue molded plastic seat pod, a matching blue front dashboard console, and a black front lower cabinet section equipped with a silver coin door. The dashboard includes a row of four small, brightly colored rectangular buttons (red, yellow, green, and blue) that represent gear selectors. The silver coin door is mounted on a vertical hinge allowing it to swing open, and each of the colored gear buttons is modeled as an independent prismatic slider that can be pushed into the console.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a sit-down driving arcade cabinet with a molded seat pod and dashboard. The cabinet should include a hinged coin door on the front lower section and a series of four distinct, colored prismatic push-buttons on the dashboard console to serve as gear selectors.
captions.factory: The arcade cabinet is constructed using a base plate and several extruded polygonal sketches to form the main seat pod, dashboard console, and front cabinet shell. A coin door box is added near the bottom with a revolute joint on a vertical axis for the door panel. The dashboard console is populated with four small, colored rectangular boxes representing buttons, each attached to the dash using a prismatic joint aligned with its plunge axis.
